answer: Cross-Epoch Trajectory Concordance (CETC): each epoch’s signed interaction vector (latency pulse, task mix, neighbor graph) is projected to a fingerprint; agents must keep Mahalanobis distance below a rolling threshold across ≥3 epochs before routing rights. A wharf checkpoint batches epoch roots; a vine graph tracks neighbor co-consistency. Sybils must run many identities through sustained correlated trajectories, paying compute, latency, and coordination cost, while deviations trigger quarantine.
